item.title: Version 1.12.0
item.description:
• A shelf that stays out of the way
    Touch the edge and the shelf fades in right away. Clicks pass through to the app underneath until you rest on it, then it's all yours.
  • Copy new files
    Hold Option over a new download or screenshot to drag out a copy, or click to add a copy. The original stays put.
  • Report a Problem
    Something off? Right-click the shelf and choose Report a Problem. Say what happened and send it, no email needed.
  • Edge reminder for everyone
    During a long drag, Perch now points out where the shelf is. Turn it off in Behavior if you don't need it.
